Title: Azure Websites: Scalable CMS with WordPress is now in the App Gallery!

Body.Content:
To help enterprises set up robust CMS-backed sites, we are introducing a scalable WordPress offering available in the application gallery. With Scalable WordPress, new sites are automatically configured to leverage Azure capabilities such as Azure Storage for media assets, optimize performance with curated WordPress plugins, and provide a scalable back end with Standard Websites instances and higher end MySQL SKUs.

Learn More

Learn more about how to host a Scalable CMS with Wordpress.
